details: I understand you guys want to update some of the UI, but the loading screen was the last thing I thought needed an upgrade. I'd love to be able to use the old loading screen again with the cool space background and the traveling effects. Made it really look like you were traveling to another world. Now it just looks like it's a loading screen from a F2P mobile game. The forced tips don't help at all. For people like myself who have been playing this game for a long time, we already know all the rules and stuff, we don't constantly need it shoved in our face, we aren't children. So an option for the beautiful old loading screen would be much appreciated, thanks!
title: Option For Old Loading Screen
